caption: The drawing depicts a piece of dark green fabric with a rounded bottom edge and straight top, possibly representing an embroidered textile. The fabric is decorated with an array of floral designs in various colors, including pink, red, blue, white, and brown. The flowers are distributed symmetrically around the fabric, with garlands of leaves and flowers forming an oval-shaped border near the center. Within this central oval, there is a brown basket filled with assorted flowers in shades of pink, red, and brown, along with green foliage. At the top of the oval, a wreath encloses the embroidered red text "Filh Walet." Smaller bunches of florals fill the spaces around the oval and the edge of the fabric, with sprigs and clusters made up of leaves and various types of blooms. The bottom and sides of the fabric are edged with a fine, repeating border pattern that includes leaves in muted shades of green and brown interspersed with small red flowers. The artist’s signature "J.Z. Lefevere" is written in the bottom right corner outside the decorated area on a plain beige background.
title: Embroidered Coverlet
